description: `(q) => match @k { given q :> … }` — a `given` arm naming an enclosing LAMBDA's parameter gets no false E-SCOPE-001 (S462 review X1). A match inside a lambda is not re-read by the statement parser; it keeps main's behaviour (filed: the single-reader redesign).
rationale: §42.2.3: a `given` head names variables in scope; a lambda parameter is in scope inside the lambda. The re-read checked the arm in the owning statement's scope, which excludes the lambda's parameters.
